description: This file defines an Android activity named DigitalWatchFaceWearableConfigActivity, which provides a user interface for configuring the appearance of a digital watch face on wearable devices. It primarily manages a list of colors for background customization, handles user interactions for selecting a color, and communicates configuration changes via GoogleApiClient to the connected watch face service.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceWearableConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that provides a user interface to select and update the background color of a digital watch face on wearable devices. It implements listener interfaces for handling list item clicks and scroll events, manages GoogleApiClient connection to synchronize configuration data, and updates the watch face configuration based on user selection.

classes.name: ColorListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for rendering a list of color options within a WearableListView, managing the creation and binding of color item views.

classes.name: ColorItem
classes.description: A custom layout class representing a color option, supporting animations for selection and focus states, containing a label and a circular color indicator.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and establishes GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when the activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when the activity stops.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on color list items, updates configuration data with the selected color, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events; currently no operation.

methods.name: onAbsoluteScrollChange
methods.description: Animates the header translation based on scroll amount.

methods.name: updateConfigDataItem
methods.description: Creates a DataMap with the selected background color and updates the data layer to sync with the watch face.
